summary: San Francisco Bay Area, robotics engineer, self-taught in cryptography, strong advocate for open-source technology, interested in mesh networking and encrypted communications, has experience with Kickstarter projects, designs and builds electronic hardware, passionate about privacy and security, critical of traditional banking systems, engaged in discussions about government surveillance, has a history of building robots since age 15, involved in the maker community, has a background in electronics and programming, interested in virtual reality and its implications for work and society, prefers working from home, has a flexible family structure.
